# EML Attachment Remover 3.0.2

This corrective release completes cross-platform qualification of the MIME-pruned
working-copy pipeline. It proves the exact Darwin native descriptor-address query in
the portable release suite and requires generated Hypothesis evidence before release
publication while preserving v3's safety boundary: retained
`text/plain` and `text/html` payloads remain source bytes, only explicitly authorized
attachment or related non-root subtrees are removed, and ambiguous input is rejected
rather than guessed. Retain originals and regenerate any v2-derived files from those
originals.

Verify downloaded artifacts before installation:

```sh
shasum -a 256 --check SHA256SUMS
gh attestation verify remove-eml-attachments.pyz --repo resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover
python3.14 remove-eml-attachments.pyz --version
```
